englishTitle: Transposition Concentration and Tree-to-Graph Divergence Study 1 — Prospective exact validation of branch reconvergence, multi-parent RAW states, duplicate occurrences, and bounded local tree-to-RAW-graph divergence in Bao
japaneseTitle: Baoにおけるtransposition集中とtree/graph乖離のprospective exact検証 — bounded RAW局所構造におけるbranch reconvergence、multi-parent state、duplicate occurrence、tree occurrence / RAW graph divergenceの再現可能なphase差の検証

rawPrimitiveSemantics.treeNodeOccurrence: depth-labelled tree occurrence; root occurs once at depth 0
rawPrimitiveSemantics.uniqueRawState: RAW state identity only; depth layer state set deduplicates within that depth
rawPrimitiveSemantics.globalDistinctRawState: RAW identity deduplicated across all depth layers 0..5
rawPrimitiveSemantics.duplicateEncounter: for a child within one parent-depth layer, each distinct incoming RAW-parent/move/RAW-child transition beyond the first; same-parent different-move arrivals can contribute
rawPrimitiveSemantics.multiParentRawState: child RAW state with at least two distinct parent RAW state identities in the same parent-depth layer; same-parent different-move alone does not qualify
rawPrimitiveSemantics.reconvergentRawState: depth-labelled RAW state carrying at least two distinct root-move branch labels
rawPrimitiveSemantics.crossDepthRawStateRevisitPresenceExcess: sum(uniqueRawStateCount[d], d=0..5) minus global distinctRawStates; contextual repeated RAW-state presence across depths, not a cycle proof
rawPrimitiveSemantics.firstReconvergenceDepth: smallest depth with at least one reconvergent RAW state under root-branch-label semantics; null when none occurs through depth 5
rawPrimitiveSemantics.rootBranchPairOverlap: F3 exact descendant RAW-state overlap for unordered root-move pairs by depth

TCTGD-C1-CUMULATIVE-TREE-RAW-RATIO.zeroDenominatorRule: undefined; expected impossible for a valid root

TCTGD-C2-DUPLICATE-UNIQUE-TRANSITION-FRA.depthLabelling: preserved; a transition identity appearing at different depths contributes once per depth layer
TCTGD-C2-DUPLICATE-UNIQUE-TRANSITION-FRA.interpretation: depth-labelled duplicate-arrival concentration; not identical to multi-parent concentration

TCTGD-C4-RECONVERGENCE-ONSET-SCORE.arithmetic: exact integer represented as rational denominator 1
TCTGD-C4-RECONVERGENCE-ONSET-SCORE.directionMeaning: smaller means earlier root-branch reconvergence; 6 means none observed through depth 5

TCTGD-C5-ROOT-BRANCH-OVERLAP-FRACTION.numerator: number of unordered root-move pairs with positive F3 descendant RAW-state overlap at any depth 1..5
TCTGD-C5-ROOT-BRANCH-OVERLAP-FRACTION.interpretation: fraction of root branches that reconverge in descendant RAW-state membership within the bounded horizon

stage1Promotion.promotion: all coverage, nonzero, and dominant-direction gates pass

stage2FormalValidation.test: exact two-sided sign test on nonzero paired differences
stage2FormalValidation.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise alpha 1/20 across the frozen promoted set
stage2FormalValidation.arithmetic: exact integer/rational only; no floating point p-value decision
stage2FormalValidation.directionGate: observed dominant direction must equal frozen Stage 1 direction
stage2FormalValidation.candidateConfirmation: coverage + nonzero + direction + sequential Holm gate all pass

trajectoryPolicy.mtajiRoot: first nonterminal phase mtaji state at ply >= 44
trajectoryPolicy.pairEligibility: both roots must exist and pass all prospective identity/firewall checks; otherwise reject entire source seed
trajectoryPolicy.selection: source seed ascending, first N eligible pairs

g302Handling.reason: canonical G3-02 root registry was not durably materialized; reconstructing it would violate the no-rescue boundary
g302Handling.freshnessProtection: entire G3-02 Stage 1 and Stage 2 seed namespaces are forbidden; no G3-02 scientific outcome enters selection

availableUpstreamIdentityOnlyExclusion: G3-01 identity records when already canonical and available

executionIntegrity.scientificWorkflowTrigger: workflow_dispatch only; push-triggered scientific computation prohibited
executionIntegrity.concurrency: single stage-specific concurrency group; queued duplicate must encounter durable execution lease and exit before scientific computation
executionIntegrity.preComputationExecutionLease: remote execution-start marker must be committed successfully before any fresh seed/root generation; non-fast-forward or existing marker aborts before computation
executionIntegrity.resultDurability: scientific-result, execution-summary, and telemetry bytes are uploaded as durable GitHub Actions artifact with hashes before repository mirror push
executionIntegrity.repositoryMirror: commit/push after durable artifact upload; push failure does not authorize recomputation
executionIntegrity.pushFailureRecovery: copy exact bytes from the already uploaded run artifact only, verify pre-recorded hashes, no engine import or scientific recomputation

failureRules.candidateCoverageGateFailure: candidate non-promoted/non-confirmed as applicable; if no evaluable endpoint remains, NON-ESTIMABLE

interpretationBoundary: cycle or recurrence claim from cross-depth presence excess alone

noRescue.activatesAt: first generation or read of Stage 1 fresh scientific evidence, whichever occurs first
